boundary: Exact finite-field and Teichmuller-unit arithmetic. Mapping the repository A4/S4 orientation bit to the two norm cosets is a proposed encoding convention, not yet derived from a hardware Hamiltonian.
gauge_invariance: For every u with N(u)=1, N(u z)=N(z); the norm sign is invariant under the full finite unitary phase gauge.
orientation_encoding: The abstract orientation/parity bit may be encoded in the two norm cosets. This is a canonical binary channel compatible with the F9 glue arithmetic and immune to multiplication by norm-one phase gauges.
theorem: The F9 phase alphabet carries a canonical gauge-invariant C2 norm character. Its kernel is exactly the order-4 unitary phase subgroup generated by the glue complex structure i, so a binary orientation channel can be encoded without absolute phase.
